# TracktCRM

> TracktCRM is an AI CRM for sales teams. It captures leads, answers them instantly over WhatsApp, email and SMS, and keeps pipelines organized for real estate, agencies, consultants and freelancers.

## Site
- Homepage: https://tracktcrm.com/
- Real Estate CRM: https://tracktcrm.com/real-estate-crm
- Sitemap: https://tracktcrm.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://tracktcrm.com/robots.txt

## Product
TracktCRM helps teams capture portal and WhatsApp enquiries, automate follow-ups, schedule site visits, manage brokers/channel partners, and track deals from enquiry to close.
